activation_order: require all eight fixed source constants
open trusted workspace descriptor chain from / with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and fstat UID/modes
open every fixed pin descriptor-relative and verify 0600 owner, exact bytes/SHA, canonical fields, role/subject/APPROVED status
lazily create a PID-bound process token that refreshes after fork
open held runtime parent and publish
admission: scan all four claim slots and all four terminal slots
validate every present artifact before deciding
enforce strict completed prefix and at most one active claim
deny UNKNOWN successors, PID reuse, process restart, active concurrency, elapsed deadline, malformed or later artifact
build one ADMIT claim from receipt IDs and internal process/time
on race validate winner namespace and deny loser
acquire nonblocking exclusive root flock for each slot publication; scans acquire nonblocking shared flock
write claim/terminal to fixed O_EXCL stage, full-write/file-fsync/parent-fsync/reopen/hash, no-replace link final, parent-fsync, then publish hash-bound slot marker last
retain both stages through marker parent-fsync; scanners reject every stage, unmarked final, marker without final, or hash mismatch
only after durable marker verification remove stages and fsync cleanup; any pre-cleanup crash remains fail-closed and cannot authorize a dependent transition
issuance: create/open a random owner-private stage root, hold its descriptor, atomically rename it to the fixed child with RENAME_EXCL, and verify path/fd identity
reverify fixed-child path/fd identity after marker-last publication; a swap never redirects held-descriptor writes and is denied
no-replace receipt publish and parent fsync
no-replace marker publish last and parent fsync
hold exclusive root flock across receipt and marker stages, final links, both parent fsyncs, stage cleanup, and exact recovery
retain both receipt stages until marker parent fsync succeeds; any stage makes recovery INCOMPLETE_WINDOW_NO_REISSUE
recovery takes shared nonblocking root flock, so the visible pre-fsync interval returns NAMESPACE_BUSY rather than authority

publish_terminal: terminal_state only; no root, clock, IDs, PID, or process token

recovery.authenticated_binding: receipt template SHA and all eight references must exactly equal current preflight-authenticated values
recovery.claim_time: every recovered claim timestamp must be within start/ordinal deadlines and wall/monotonic drift bound
recovery.committed_receipt: return exact marker-bound bytes without minting
recovery.fork_identity: PID change invalidates inherited cached token and creates fresh entropy only after activation pins
recovery.receipt_commit: committed means final receipt+marker with exact hash and both stages absent under shared root lock; marker parent-fsync failure and concurrent pre-fsync recovery never authorize
recovery.slot_commit: for each of four claim and four terminal slots, committed means final data plus exact marker and no stage files; any incomplete combination fences the whole namespace

terminal: require exact active claim and same internal PID/process token
hash-bind terminal to canonical exact claim
validate completed namespace then advance once
exact replay and mismatched replay both deny
terminal final is never authority without its durable slot commit marker and absent stages
claim/terminal fsync or parent-fsync failure cannot authorize terminal publication or the next claim

time.deadline_edge: inclusive then deny first later nanosecond

verification_gate.schema_validator: project-local jsonschema is mandatory; import failure is test failure, never silent skip
